title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 concurrency ladder: vLLM one-shot baseline
subtitle: vLLM + MTP, C=1..16 (throughput) and C=1..128 (energy leg), on the published ladder instrument; no Metrale Engine leg at this instrument yet
aggregate: mean tok/s over 3 timed reps (1 warmup discarded)
subject_note: No series has role "subject": no Metrale Engine run exists at this instrument for this checkpoint yet (PR #112 registers the gate id concurrency-sweep-moe-nvfp4 as a PROMOTION_CANDIDATE, unmeasured). This manifest mirrors bench/baselines/qwen36-35b-a3b/published.json (the FP8 MoE sibling) so that when a Metrale leg is hand-measured at this instrument, it is added here as a series with role "subject" and scored against this one the same way.
version_note: ★ IMPORTANT: this is NOT vLLM 0.27.1. `docker pull vllm/vllm-openai:latest` on dgx3 on 2026-10-05 resolved to v0.31.0 (image id sha256:bbe7045055707d1027079ed01cca40812578a235c56032d85c16108ad473384c, repo digest vllm/vllm-openai@sha256:c1c9f6fd5c109ba7f0546a59f5b2f15fb87f64c77782e90a27b648b42a8e67c3, created 2026-10-03). The FP8 MoE sibling's published.json pins v0.27.1 explicitly (sha256:2c211a1273b4...) on dgx2; dgx3's `:latest` tag had moved on by the time this ran. Found by `docker image inspect`, not assumed -- disclosed here rather than mislabeled as 0.27.1 to match the sibling or the informal same-box A/B (moenvfp4/lean_ab) that preceded this, which described itself as "vLLM 0.27.1 (Marlin+MTP3)" without a verified image digest. This version gap is a real difference between this baseline and the FP8 sibling's: do not read the two as apples to apples on engine version, only on checkpoint family and instrument. A newer vLLM is plausibly faster, which this measurement's numbers (3-7% above the informal same-box A/B's vLLM arm at most rungs) are consistent with, though that comparison is confounded by the harness also differing (checked-in harness_w55/w56 here vs an uncommitted driver there, driver_sha256 7b3efab2e6... matching neither).

series.label: vLLM + MTP
parity_deltas: vLLM version is v0.31.0, not the v0.27.1 pinned by the FP8 sibling's vllm-mtp series (see version_note) -- not adjudicated against a Metrale leg since none exists at this instrument yet

ctx 2048, max_num_seqs 128, util 0.85, kv_cache_dtype fp8, dtype bfloat16, MTP num_speculative_tokens=3 -- same shape as the FP8 sibling's profile, chosen as a best-effort match, not oracle-adjudicated (no Metrale NVFP4 leg exists yet to adjudicate parity against)
series.env_note: VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND is logged by this vLLM version as an unrecognized environment variable (no-op) -- it auto-selects Marlin regardless; engine logs confirm 'Using MarlinNvFp4LinearKernel for NVFP4 GEMM' and the MARLIN NvFp4 MoE backend.
series.cli: docker run -d --name <rung> --network host --gpus all --ipc=host -v /home/claude/.cache/huggingface:/root/.cache/huggingface -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND=marlin -e VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=0 -e PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True vllm/vllm-openai:latest --model nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 --served-model-name nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8010 --max-model-len 2048 --max-num-seqs 128 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --enable-prefix-caching --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}'
series.instrument_note: prompt_mode essay: the harness defaults to it (PROMPT_MODE = os.environ.get('W55_PROMPT_MODE', 'essay')) and this run's env did not set it. Fresh container per rung group (narrow leg C=1,2,4,8,16 on one serve; C=32/64/128 each its own fresh container), the mitigation that let the FP8 sibling's wide rungs complete without a wedge on 2026-09-28 (memory vllm-c128-wedges-gb10) -- this run also completed all rungs, zero wedges, zero request errors.

unmeasured.reason: the throughput leg (w55, no power sampling) stops at C=16 by the same convention as the FP8 sibling's vllm-mtp series; C=32/64/128 throughput is read from the energy leg instead, which measured them successfully (see vllm-mtp-energy below) -- not a memory or stability limit this time, every rung completed clean.

parity_deltas: vLLM version is v0.31.0, not v0.27.1 (see version_note)
same best-effort, non-adjudicated profile as vllm-mtp above
series.cli: vllm-mtp's command, verbatim, run separately per rung-group (see fresh-container note above)
series.instrument_note: Energy = GPU RAIL via an NVML cumulative-energy-counter sidecar sampled through the run (nvml_energy_sidecar.py), gpu_rail_energy_j per rep, the same metric name the FP8 sibling's energy leg reports. C=1,2,4,8,16 ran together on one serve (the narrow leg); C=32,64,128 each ran on its own fresh container -- the wide-rung mitigation (memory vllm-c128-wedges-gb10). A stall_probe.py (2s cadence, 180s-no-progress / <1GB-MemAvailable thresholds) and an independent ping/ssh/metrics watchdog from dgx1 (30s cadence) ran throughout every rung; neither ever fired. Lowest observed host MemAvailable across the whole campaign and highest GPU temp were not separately logged in this pass but no distress or stall was flagged at any rung.
